findings.title: Windows git CRLF warnings pollute drydock output (13 lines)
findings.detail: Fix candidate: add .gitattributes (* text=auto eol=lf) to drydock seed. Source: docs/dogfood/log.md Run#1

findings.title: drydock suggests `omc doctor` but is not executable outside an OMC session
findings.detail: Fix candidate: make OMC detection optional. Source: docs/dogfood/log.md Run#1

findings.title: Solo dogfood: agent plays both human and agent roles, C1-C5 exercised with zero real-user friction cost
findings.detail: Evaluation limitation, not a skill defect — needs a real human rerun. Source: docs/dogfood/log.md Run#1

findings.title: launch lacks a brief-quality self-check list before Phase 1
findings.detail: Fix candidate: add brief self-check (objective named? scope boundary named? non-goals?) to launch skill. Source: docs/dogfood/log.md Run#1

findings.title: Cross-ticket integration gap: T3 static files were never wired into the server
findings.detail: T3 delivered public/ but server wiring belonged to no ticket; T5 had to add src/static.js. Fix candidate: launch Phase 3 must give every slice its wiring + smoke assertion, or add an explicit integration ticket.

findings.title: Headless launch: orchestrator timeout killed session mid-Phase-4
findings.detail: Recovery via claude --continue + on-disk paper trail was near-zero cost. Fix candidate: launch hygiene section should suggest --output-format stream-json (or periodic progress markers) for long headless runs so the orchestrator sees liveness. Source: Run 2.
